name: Turism, Hoteluri, Restaurante Marea Neagra S.A.

profile.description: Turism, Hoteluri, Restaurante Marea Neagra S.A. engages in the provision of tourist accommodation, public catering, and entertainment services in Romania. It operates hotels, restaurants, bars, buffets, and spas. The company was formerly known as S.C. Eforie S.A. and changed its name to Turism, Hoteluri, Restaurante Marea Neagra S.A. in January 2005. Turism, Hoteluri, Restaurante Marea Neagra S.A. was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Constanta, Romania.
